This page remains the focused reference for irregular forms; use the study list for complete course-sheet practice and the master table for chapter context. ## English meanings from master\_vocab.json English glosses for irregular-reference entries that were not included in the existing table: | Dutch verb | English | | --- | --- | | aandoen | to put on, switch on | | aankomen | to arrive | | afspreken | to arrange, agree | | afwassen | to wash up | | bakken | to bake, fry | | bevallen | to please, appeal to; to give birth | | dragen | to wear, carry | | innemen | to take (medicine); to occupy | | kijken | to look, watch | | klimmen | to climb | | krijgen | to get, receive | | kunnen | can, to be able to | | meebrengen | to bring along | | meegaan | to go along | | meenemen | to take along | | moeten | must, to have to | | mogen | may, to be allowed to | | rijden | to ride, drive | | scheiden | to separate, divorce | | uitdoen | to switch off, take off | | uitlezen | to finish reading | | verkopen | to sell | | vertrekken | to leave, depart | | zoeken | to look for, search |
